Question: As salam aleikum,iam a working women and would like to divorce my husband which i have already informed him verbally,from last 8months i and my my daughter are staying with my parents. since my daughter birth iam the only one who has taken care of her in all the ways,koi bhi reponsiblities nahin nibhayi,10years i worked alone and he used to sit at home.Now when i have decided to divorce him same time i got the offer letter from Dubai....in this situation is it necessary or complusary to complete the iddah period.If i do so i will miss the opportunity as they can't wait till i complete my iddah. Answer ID: 10931 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 248/248=M/1430) In Islamic Shariah, husband owes the right to give talaq, wife cannot give talaq to her husband with her own consent only. And, when the talaq will not take place then it is useless to sit in iddah . You should file your case in any local Darul Qaza or Sharyi Panchayat if your husband did not fulfil your needs, in-shaAllah your grievance will be resolved. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
